question: The ocean has _________ main temperature layers.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ocean has three main temperature layers: **
 
• **Surface layer**
 
 
• Also known as the mixed layer, this top layer is about 500 meters thick and has temperatures between 20° and 25° C.
 
 
 
• **Thermoclin**e
 
 
• This layer is about 500–1000 meters thick and is characterized by a rapid decrease in temperature with increasing depth.
 
 
 
• **Deep ocean**
 
 
• This layer is very cold and extends up to the ocean floor.
 
• The temperature change with depth is very slight in this layer.
 
 
 
• The** temperature of the ocean plays a significant role in the Earth's climate, marine life, and ecosystems.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of ocean**

 
 

 
 
Oceans

 
 Important information
 
 

 Pacific ocean
 It is the largest and deepest ocean. Most of the Islands of this ocean are volcanic or of coral reef. Mariana trench is the world's deepest trench with a depth of 11033 meters, exists in the pacific ocean. 
 
 

 Atlantic ocean
 It has the longest coastline. It is the busiest ocean for trade and commerce since its sea routes connect the two most industrialized regions, namely Western Europe and the North-Eastern United States of America. Puerto Rico Trench is the deepest point in this ocean. 
 
 

 Indian ocean
 Only ocean named after a country. It is deeper than the Atlantic ocean. Here the number of continental islands are more in number than the volcanic islands. Java trench is the deepest point of this ocean. 
 
 

 Arctic ocean
 It is the smallest ocean and lies within the arctic circle. The North pole lies in the middle of this ocean. Most of the part is frozen of this ocean. Nansen's trench is the deepest point of this ocean.
